response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS overall_avg FROM r) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed, r.txn_count, r.avg_signed / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: trans.date is stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD' text with no time part, so the inclusive text comparison '1996-05-09' to '1998-01-06' covers the stated range.

The average of the regional averages is an unweighted mean over regions that have a non-null average. A region with only other or missing types has a null average and is left out of that mean. It still appears in the output with its transaction count.
VYBER and any other undocumented types are left out of the signed average, as the request says, but they are counted in the transaction count.
